import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Create a violin plot to visualize the distribution of transaction amounts by fraud status
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.violinplot(x='is_fraud', y='amount', data=data, hue='transaction_type', split=True)

# Add labels and title
plt.xlabel('Fraud Status (0 = Not Fraud, 1 = Fraud)')
plt.ylabel('Transaction Amount')
plt.title('Distribution of Transaction Amounts by Fraud Status and Transaction Type')
plt.legend(title='Transaction Type', loc='upper right')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
